dedupe_keys.name: resilience of transportation infrastructure networks to road failures code and pre computed results

description: This Zenodo deposit holds the code and pre-computed results behind a study of how road networks withstand road failures, by Jonas Wassmer, Bruno Merz and Norbert Marwan, published in the journal Chaos in 2024. The full computation on the road networks is heavy, so the authors ran it on a cluster and share the results, and Jupyter notebooks let users rerun a smaller example locally. The record has a single zip of 502 MB, written in Python, licensed CC-BY-4.0 with MIT for the code, and free to download. It was published on 25 March 2024, so it counts as inactive under the two-year rule. Coverage follows the networks used in the paper and the record lists keywords on natural hazards, floods and climate impact. Caveats: the archive was not opened, the results are tied to the paper's network set, and there is no update plan. It suits studies of network resilience, cascading failure and hazard-driven road disruption. No closely related catalogue record was identified in this pass.
